Overview

Pune is a city in Maharashtra with a population of 6,200,000. A major educational and IT hub known as the ‘Oxford of the East,’ with a pleasant climate, historic landmarks, and a growing startup scene. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
